# vendors/github

Facts about GitHub, one per file in `graph/nodes/`, listed in `INDEX.md`.

## Attribution

Each fact quotes GitHub's documentation and names the page it was read from: `source` is that page's URL, and `attrs.quote` is a short passage copied from it without change.

The quoted text is from GitHub Docs (https://docs.github.com) by GitHub, licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); its source repository is github/docs (https://github.com/github/docs). The quotes are reproduced unmodified. The ids, names, verdicts, values and edges around them are this repository's own, and GitHub does not endorse them.
